episode_notes: A Telugu romantic comedy where Abhi conceals his wealthy background and goes by the name 'Vijay' to live near his crush Meera. His friend and family match Harshitha visits and threatens his cover before gracefully deciding not to interfere, just as his father tracks him down. Clipping the identity slips or father's search reveals the core deception central to the plot.
